title: New Invite Application Form for Lok Adalat

source.name: Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee

text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
To,
The Secretary
DHCLSC, New Delhi.
Sub: Application to refer pending Case No. ………………... title as
..................................................................................................................... to Lok Adalat.
Sir,
The claimant/ insurance company in the abovementioned matters wants to settle
the case in Lok Adalat. As per Claimant/Insurance Company the grounds of
enhancement/reduction of compensation are on following heads:
Sr. No. Grounds of enhancement of compensation Approximate Amount
1. Multiplier
2. Pecuniary/non-pecuniary damages
3. Loss of working capacity in relation to
disability
4. Any other head
TOTAL
Pending connected Appeal/ case, if any. .....................................................................
DECLARATION
Applicant/ claimant further declare that the above said particulars are true and
correct to the best of his knowledge.
Date: ……………….. (Signature of Claimant/Insurance Co./Counsel)
